name: 2026 Shexian Huangshan Maofeng - Spring Selection
marketing_tip: Freshly harvested spring tea from the historic Shexian region.
body: This 2026 spring harvest Huangshan Maofeng comes from Shexian, one of the core production areas. It offers a classic Maofeng profile with a bright liquor and a sweet, lingering aftertaste.
